leftEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
leftEvidence.title: Moses asks what the land and its inhabitants are like

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Moses directs the men through the Negev into the hill country and asks about people, cities, soil, trees, and strength.
points.right: Caleb silences the people before Moses and calls for immediate ascent and possession.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: He tells them to be courageous and bring fruit; the season is identified as the first ripe grapes.
points.right: His confidence is stated against the report of strong cities and inhabitants.

payload.posture: Moses asks for evidence about strength, cities, soil, trees, and fruit; Caleb responds to the resulting report with immediate action.

rightEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
rightEvidence.title: Caleb quiets the people and urges immediate possession

payload.tension: Caleb does not deny the obstacles that the mission was commissioned to observe.
payload.title: Observation and the call to act
